digest.component_or_area: code-review gate criteria routing and blocking
propositions: correctness and edge-cases dimensions lack explicit routing entries in criteria_routing.json and resolve through the unknown-criterion default (0.95/non-blocking) despite being the 3rd and 4th largest un-routed dimensions by volume
measured friction at 0.54 threshold is correctness 4.04% and edge-cases 1.74% of all changes, both within the 8.0% operator-accepted budget recorded on the tests entry

correctness and edge-cases must be routed as base-reviewer dimensions at blocking/0.54/true with inert exec/applies_to fields, while concurrency remains advisory due to n=1 measurement falling below the calibration script's MIN_N=25 power floor

the calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py script lacks a --block-impact mode to compute reproducible friction tables, and replay_code_v4_would_block.py hard-codes its blocking set instead of deriving it from routing_index()
